Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:193612

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 43534 of 2024
Applicant :- Charan Singh

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Kushagra Srivastava,Rohit Rai,Shahrukh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Shahrukh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Shatrughan Yadav, learned Aga,
for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release
him on bail in Case Crime No.420 of 2024, under Sections 304-B and 498-A Ipc and Section 3/4
Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Hapur Nagar, District Hapur during pendency of the trial.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is the father-in-law of the deceased and
on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture he has been made accused in the
present matter along with his family members including his son, i.e., husband of deceased.

4.  He further submits that actually after marriage 'dever' of the deceased started living separately with his wife and thereafter deceased also started making pressure upon her husband to live separately but after leaving his parents her husband was not ready to live separately and only due to this reason very often dispute arose between husband and wife and only due to this reason she Charan Singh vs State Of U.P. on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24432447/
1 committed suicide by hanging herself.

entities.text: Charan Singh vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He next submits, after considering this fact the bail application of mother-in-law has been allowed by this Court vide order dated 28.11.2024 passed in Criminal Misc.Bail Application No. 42499 of 2024.
5. He further submits that post mortem report of the deceased also suggests that she died due to hanging.
6. He further submits that there is no specific allegation against the applicant and it appears that only being father-in-law of the deceased he has been made accused in the present matter.
7. He further submits that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 16.7.2024.

8. Per contra, learned AGA, however, opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant is the father-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against him and post mortem report suggests that deceased died due to hanging.

He further could not dispute,
mother-in-law of the deceased has been released on bail.
9. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. Considering the argument advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant and the fact that applicant is the father-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against him and post mortem report of the deceased suggests that deceased died due to hanging and mother-in-law of the deceased has been released on bail and applicant is in jail in the present matter for the last more than four months, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
11. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

12. Let the applicant-Charan Singh be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
13. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
